quality_issues.title: Forecast versus forecast is not forecast versus actual
quality_issues.observation: Crysvita, Vyjuvek, Givlaari and Skyclarys directions are primarily old-versus-current peak comparisons.
quality_issues.treatment: Split realized error, forecast revisions and operational lessons; do not pool them into one beat rate.

quality_issues.title: Preapproval ranges contain postapproval estimates
quality_issues.observation: Spinraza $1.6bn is dated September 2017; Zolgensma $2.8bn is August 2019; Evrysdi includes August 10, 2020.
quality_issues.treatment: Rebuild from dated originals before respective approval dates.

quality_issues.title: PoS handling is not fully established
quality_issues.observation: Deck says unadjusted, but Bernstein Evrysdi row mentions 90% probability.
quality_issues.treatment: Retain compiler declaration as evidence; recover exact location of probability in model; do not automatically divide.

quality_issues.title: Strensiq initial range omits a cited larger forecast
quality_issues.observation: P.4 gives $0.5–1bn for 2012–2014; p.7 cites BofA September 30, 2014 at $1.6bn.
quality_issues.treatment: Document vintage and selection rules; preserve all eligible estimates before aggregation.

quality_issues.title: Later disease indication retained
quality_issues.observation: Crysvita TIO is included and described as marginal without a numerical allocation.
quality_issues.treatment: Exclude mixed XLH/TIO sales from strict sample until separated or bounded; label age expansion separately.

quality_issues.title: Geography shifts may change the opportunity rather than reveal error
quality_issues.observation: LATAM/EU expansion is called upside without the original geographic scope.
quality_issues.treatment: US-only forecasts must be compared with US actuals; add territories only in a separately defined analysis.

quality_issues.title: Population denominators change
quality_issues.observation: Crysvita table compares 9,000 US adults with 36,000 global adults.
quality_issues.treatment: Do not interpret this as a fourfold epidemiology revision.

quality_issues.title: SMA route and product scope are mixed
quality_issues.observation: 2019 Zolgensma is labeled IT, but approval was IV; some estimates explicitly combine IV/IT.
quality_issues.treatment: Separate original Zolgensma from intrathecal franchise expectations; retain fast followers outside first-DMT cohort.

quality_issues.title: SMA revenue-owner reconciliation needed
quality_issues.observation: Evaluate table has Roche and Chugai Evrysdi rows; 2025 total appears to include both.
quality_issues.treatment: Verify end-market conventions before summing. Also distinguish 2025 Zolgensma Group from original IV sales.

quality_issues.title: Skyclarys persistence anecdotes lack a generalizable denominator
quality_issues.observation: 48% at six months and up to 75% discontinuation in some practices are cited from surveys/expert summaries.
quality_issues.treatment: Recover population, follow-up, dose-reduction definitions and pharmacy coverage; compare with original observational cohorts.

quality_issues.title: Market-size accuracy is not demonstrated by summing product peaks
quality_issues.observation: Forecasts were made in different years with different competitor knowledge.
quality_issues.treatment: Use contemporaneous, same-horizon total-SMA forecasts before making a market-accuracy claim.

quality_issues.title: Strensiq age-at-treatment and age-at-onset differ
quality_issues.observation: Adults with pediatric-onset HPP are not equivalent to adult-onset disease; the reproduced model is January 2016.
quality_issues.treatment: Use the table as postapproval mechanism evidence, not a preapproval forecast or proof of adult efficacy for CMP-002.

quality_issues.title: Date, currency and value inconsistencies
quality_issues.observation: March 2020 row cites September 2019; $3.8bn row describes $3.5bn; CHF-to-USD translation is not specified.
quality_issues.treatment: Preserve raw entries, quarantine transformations and obtain originals.

quality_issues.title: Universal price-conservatism conclusion is unsupported
quality_issues.observation: Daybue and Crysvita descriptions include material pricing surprises; price and adult mix interact.
quality_issues.treatment: Decompose net price, body weight, utilization and patient mix within each case.

quality_issues.title: No complete cohort or annual curves
quality_issues.observation: Selected products and peak ranges cannot identify a systematic signed three-year error.
quality_issues.treatment: Keep the original strict endpoint; add a labeled exploratory single-year comparison track.

quality_issues.title: Causal attribution exceeds the reproduced evidence
quality_issues.observation: Many mechanisms are later syntheses/expert reports, with no quantitative patient-price-revenue bridge.
quality_issues.treatment: Treat as hypotheses; seek contemporaneous forecasts and independent patient, access and utilization records.

caveats: Forecast reported by deck, not authenticated original
Worldwide scope inferred from deck heading
Compiler declares unadjusted; original model risk treatment unverified
IV versus future IT scope needs reconciliation
